subject: Looking for the number of missing data (not observations) missing in a model

messages.author: dd8507309f8545e1
messages.subject: Looking for the number of missing data (not observations) missing in a model
parts:
Hello,

I ran SEM analyse,s using the method FIML. In summary, I obtain the number of missing observations and missing patterns. Is there a way to know how many missing data there was in the data used by the model, meaning "missing cases" basically ?

Thanks  a lot,

Solene

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Looking for the number of missing data (not observations) missing in a model
parts: In summary, I obtain the number of missing observations and missing patterns. Is there a way to know how many missing data there was in the data used by the model, meaning "missing cases" basically ?

How is that different from what summary() shows you?

You can get more detail about the proportion observed for each element of the covariance matrix:

lavInspect(fit, "coverage")

1 minus that matrix is the proportion missing per variable (diagonal) and per pair of variables (off-diagonal).
